name: oxen-pet
description: A pixel Luffy above the Claude Code prompt who acts out each tool call in five gears, an HP/MP/ST HUD for context, rate limits, and prompt cache, a shield that asks before destructive commands, a bug boss for failing tests, and a /pet stats pane. Your own pets live in a folder updates never touch.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: How quickly the pet runs and animates.

sleepAfter.title: Sleep after (seconds)
sleepAfter.description: Idle time before the pet falls asleep. 0 keeps it awake.

hud.title: HUD
hud.description: The HP, MP, and ST bars below the prompt.

targets.title: Name files and commands
targets.description: The status line names the file, pattern, command, host, or search query a tool works on. Off by default so a shared screen shows no file names or commands.

cacheTtl.title: Cache timer
cacheTtl.description: How long the HUD counts the prompt cache warm after a turn: 1h, 5m, or off.

minis.title: Subagent minis
minis.description: A mini behind the pet for each running subagent.

guard.title: Shield
guard.description: Ask before a destructive Bash command (rm -r, git push --force, git reset --hard, DROP TABLE, ...) runs unasked, in bypass or auto mode or by an allow rule. With no one to answer, it is blocked.

boss.title: Bug boss
boss.description: A failed test run brings a bug boss into the band; the next passing run defeats it.

hudLayout.title: HUD layout
hudLayout.description: row: the bars side by side in one line, each with its reading and one short detail; stacked on a terminal too narrow for it. stacked: one bar per line, with every detail.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The pet a session starts with, by name: a built-in one (luffy, slime, duck, alien) or <name>.theme.json in your custom folder. /pet theme lists them and switches.

customDir.title: Custom folder
customDir.description: An absolute path to the folder of your own <name>.theme.json files. Empty: ~/.claude/oxen-pet/themes, which updates never touch.
